1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Nf6 4.Ng5 Bc5 5..strategy: Accepts the sacrifice and leaves the king on the exposed f2-square, where a knight check follows at once. White is a piece up for the moment but must survive the attack, and the main lines are thought to end level, so this is a risky way to win material.

Takes a second pawn with check and keeps the white king in the open. The knight on f7 still hits the queen and rook, but grabbing the rook on h8 can end in mate, so White has to choose the king's square with care while Black brings the queen into the attack.
